content: Testing Dataset Our testing dataset takes MIMIC-III BIBREF18 and PubMed as data sources. Here we are referring to all the notes data from MIMIC-III (NOTEEVENTS table ) and Case Reports articles from PubMed, as this type of contents are close to medical notes. We provide detailed information in Appendix SECREF8, including the steps to create the testing dataset. Eventually, we have a balanced testing dataset, where each term-sense pair has at least 11 and up to 15 samples for training (on average, each pair has 14.56 samples and the median sample number is 15).
